notes.title: Sphere Guider: Update 2.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a free cam feature. Pausing the level is now done with the ESC key.
[*] Added 5 additional levels.
[*] Cleaned up some visuals.
[/list]

notes.title: Sphere Guider: 2.0.9 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]As a future catch-up mechanic, the first 10 levels are automatically unlocked on a new install. If you have been playing since the previous update and want this, you have to delete the data located at AppData/LocalLow/Velite Games.[/b]
[*] Fixed button hopping
[*] Added multi object fading
[*] Added previews for future levels
[/list]

notes.title: Sphere Guider 2.0.6 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Player jumping on pressed buttons
[*] Adjusted Intro volume
[*] Fixed skins not showing in skin selector
[/list]

notes.title: Sphere Guider 2.0.4 Update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Make most platforms that obscure the player from the camera transparent.
[*]Hotfix for a potential crash issue on level 14.
[*]Added a Join Discord button to the main menu.
[/olist]

notes.title: Sphere Guider 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Changes

[list]
[*] New Toon Shader based Art Style

[/list]
[/h2]

notes.title: Sphere Guider v1.6.2
notes.content:
[h2]Quick Hotfix[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Camera following behind objects
[*] Changed level 15 textures and lighting
[/list]

notes.title: Sphere Guider has been updated to v1.6!
notes.content:
[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Movement now has a torque component, this has a higher skill ceiling but allows for more fluid movement
[*] UI layout redesign
[*] New skins, and skin 11 is unlocked by beating level 15
[*] Level 11 ramp remodeled
[/list]

notes.title: v1.5 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Sphere Guider has been updated to v1.5[/h1]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Add visual effect to finishing level
[*] Changed perspective for level 10
[*] Adjusted kill heights for levels 10-14
[*] Added retry level button
[*] Changed cannon targeting movement
[/list]

notes.title: Sphere Guider is Released!
notes.content:
[h2]This is the initial launch of Sphere Guider for Steam.[/h2]

[h1]Stay tuned for more updates![/h1]
